messages.content: What key signature does C# major have?

function.name: music_theory_key_signature
function.description: Return the key signature of a major or minor scale. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The root of the scale, e.g., 'C', 'F#', 'Ab'.

scale_type.description: Type of the scale, either 'major' or 'minor'. Default is 'major'.

message.content:
**Key Signature of C♯ Major**

| Sharped note | Symbol |
|--------------|--------|
| F♯           | ♫      |
| C♯           | ♫      |
| G♯           | ♫      |
| D♯           | ♫      |
| A♯           | ♫      |
| E♯           | ♫      |
| B♯           | ♫      |

So **C♯ major contains all seven accidentals—seven sharps—in its key signature.**  
(If you prefer the “circle‑of‑fifths” view, C♯ major sits at the far right side and requires one more sharp than B♭ major.)
